Class StateTransitionStrings

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.statetransitionstables.StateTransitionStrings
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class StateTransitionStrings extends Object implements Serializable
A set of strings that specify the names or text of elements of a state transition that occured in a state machine during a model execution. These strings constitute a row in a state transition table. The transition strings can be formatted in a number of ways so as to provide a state transition specification for logger entries, string lists, comma-separated value (CSV) lines of text, and as table rows in HTML.
Author:
ModelerOne

      currentStateString - string representation of the current state

      transitionString - string representation of the transition that took place
      guardString - string representation of the guard on the transition
      effectString - string representation of the effect of the transition
      nextStateString - string representation of the next state after transition
